name: BYD Singapore International Marathon by Adidas
short_description: A World Athletics Gold Label road race weekend in Singapore from 4 to 6 December 2026, with the marathon on Sunday 6 December and 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races on the Friday and Saturday.
ai_summary: The BYD Singapore International Marathon presented by adidas is Singapore's national marathon, held over a race weekend from 4 to 6 December 2026. The 5 km and 10 km run on the night of Friday 4 December, the half marathon on the morning of Saturday 5 December and the marathon on the morning of Sunday 6 December. The organiser, SG International Marathon Pte Ltd, took over from IRONMAN, which ran the event until 2025 as the Standard Chartered Singapore Marathon. The marathon is a World Athletics Gold Label race.
pros: World Athletics Gold Label (the organiser says it is Southeast Asia's only one), with US$50,000 for the winners
A generous 7 hour 30 minute marathon limit, with walking allowed
Aid stations every 2 to 3 km, with cold water and ice lollies late in the 2025 race
Half marathon and marathon on separate days, so you can run both
cons: The 2025 half-marathon finish jammed, with waits of 10 to 40 minutes
Narrow two-way park paths caused congestion in the 2025 half marathon
Humid even before dawn: 26°C with a 23°C dew point at the 4.30am start
Entries are non-refundable and non-transferable, even if bad weather cancels the race
Only marathon finishers get a finisher tee

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: The weekend has four adult distances: 5 km, 10 km, a 21.1 km half marathon and a 42.195 km marathon, plus Kids Dash races over 600 m and 1.6 km. The 2026 cut-offs are 7 hours for the marathon, 3 hours 45 for the half, 2 hours 30 for the 10 km and 1 hour 15 for the 5 km.

faqs.question: Is this a World Athletics Gold Label race?
faqs.answer: Yes. The organiser describes the marathon as a World Athletics Gold Label race and says it is the only Gold Label road race in Southeast Asia. In 2025, the winners of the Gold Label elite marathon races took home US$50,000 each. The event is supported by Sport Singapore, the Singapore Tourism Board and Singapore Athletics.

faqs.question: When and where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The race weekend runs from 4 to 6 December 2026 in Singapore. The 5 km and 10 km are on Friday night, 4 December, the half marathon on Saturday morning, 5 December, and the marathon on Sunday morning, 6 December. Both the half and the marathon cross Benjamin Sheares Bridge, and the half finishes inside the National Stadium.
